not_conformance_evidence: Produced in a throwaway worktree carrying stage3-preemption-tail-diagnostic.patch, which removes conformance protections. qualify-observer refuses an active-preemption denominator and qualify-ipc refuses an inactive-preemption numerator, so no series here can become evidence for a gate. The green and red P2 records are untouched.

observer.backend: QEMU simple trace symmetric UART measurement pair

host: local developer machine; noisier than the ADR-0040 CI runner, which is why every comparison below is paired within an interleaved matrix and no absolute number here is offered as a platform figure
tick_window: the monotonic tick is read before OPEN and after CLOSE, so the attributed window is wider than the measured interval and can only over-attribute
quantum_metadata_defect: The diagnostic patch gives nucleus/src/apic.rs two cfg-selected QUANTUM constants and makes the harness report the smaller one, so every run taken after that patch — matrix 4 — records quantum_count 10000 whatever it was built with. The field is retained as reported and the effective value is stated beside it, derived from the build's own features: diag-fast-quantum selects 10000 and its absence 100000. The measurements themselves show which build ran: the reference series ticks 2.8% of intervals and the fast series 46.4%, a ratio the shared metadata could not have produced. Matrices 1 to 3 predate the patch and report correctly.
